classification.habit: Perennial sedge with underground rhizomes and tubers
classification.habitat: Grasslands, cultivated fields, wastelands and moist to seasonally dry soils
classification.distribution: Widespread in tropical and subtropical regions

identification.description: Perennial sedge forming tufts, with narrow grass-like leaves and characteristic underground rhizomes/tubers.
identification.whole_plant: Tufted perennial sedge arising from an underground rhizome system.
identification.root: Fibrous roots arise from rhizomes and basal portions.
identification.stem: Triangular, solid to pithy culm, typically erect and slender.
identification.leaf: Narrow, linear, grass-like leaves arising from the base; sheaths enclose the lower culm.
identification.flower: Inflorescence is an umbel-like cluster of spikelets, commonly reddish-brown to purplish-brown.
identification.fruit: Small three-angled achene developing within the spikelet.
identification.seed: Tiny dark to brown achene; the underground tuber/rhizome is more characteristic as crude drug material.

therapeutics.precautions: Correct botanical authentication is important because Cyperaceae species may be confused in crude material.

major_constituents: Sesquiterpenes and sesquiterpene-rich essential oil fractions
phytochemistry.chemical_notes: The rhizomes contain volatile and non-volatile constituents; composition varies with geography and chemotype.

modern_information.evidence_summary: Cyperus rotundus has been investigated experimentally for digestive, inflammatory and other pharmacological activities. These findings are not treated here as proof of clinical efficacy.
modern_information.safety_notes: Use authenticated crude drug and appropriate professional guidance for medicinal use.

viva_questions: Why is Musta placed in Cyperaceae?
How can the crude drug be authenticated?
mnemonics: Musta = must identify the underground rhizome and triangular sedge stem.
student.quick_revision: Musta (Cyperus rotundus): perennial sedge of Cyperaceae; rhizome is useful; triangular culm and brown spikelet clusters are key practical characters.

teaching_points: Compare sedge morphology with true grasses.
Demonstrate triangular culm and underground rhizome.
discussion_points: Botanical authentication of rhizomatous crude drugs
practical_points: Roll the culm between fingers to appreciate triangular section.
Examine rhizome/tuber and odour in authenticated samples.

doctor.quick_reference: Musta is traditionally used as a Deepana-Pachana and Grahi drug, particularly in digestive indications; no dose is supplied without a verified reference.
key_precautions: Use clinically appropriate references for dosing
